## Decision-Support Guardrails

This feature must not:

- recommend buy/sell actions
- guarantee outcomes
- imply certainty
- execute trades
- hold client funds
- recommend a broker as best

## Compliance / Data Rights Notes

- Does this require JSE validation?
- Does this require FSC/legal review?
- Does this involve broker referral or sponsored content?
- Does this use official, internal, demo, or third-party data?
